vendor_highlights: Launched Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview, the first Flash-Lite model in the Gemini 3 series.

changelog.text:
*     The following Gemini 2.0 models are now [shut down](/docs/deprecations):

  *   `gemini-2.0-flash`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-001`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite`
  *   `gemini-2.0-flash-lite-001`

  Use [`gemini-3.5-flash`](/docs/models/gemini-3.5-flash) or
  [`gemini-3.1-flash-lite`](/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite) instead.

*   The `gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview` model has been [shut
  down](/docs/deprecations). Use
  [`gemini-3.1-flash-lite`](/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite) instead.

*     Released `gemini-3.1-flash-lite`, the generally available (GA) version of
  [Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite](/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite), optimized for
  speed, scale, and cost efficiency.

*   Launched Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite Preview, the first Flash-Lite model in the
  Gemini 3 series. Read the [model
  page](/docs/models/gemini-3.1-flash-lite-preview) for specs, specific
  updates, and developer guidance.
